verdict: Workable: Choose Workable when you want a dedicated ATS with published SMB floors and a trial — not when you need Greenhouse-depth structured hiring, a free ATS, or payroll/HRIS as the primary job. Scores use the HR editorial methodology from first-party research as of 2026-08-17 — not hands-on product testing.
strengths: Published Standard/Premier/Enterprise floors for the 1–20 band
ATS plus optional HRIS-lite in one product
Workable Agent AI with included credits on paid plans
weaknesses: Higher headcount bands are not fully published
Agent AI excluded from the trial
Not a payroll-first or core HRIS product
bestFor: SMB and lower mid-market teams that want a dedicated ATS with published prices
Hiring teams that want a 15-day trial before a custom enterprise ATS quote
Companies that may use Workable’s light HR features without buying a full HRIS
notIdealFor: Structured-hiring enterprises standardised on Greenhouse kits/scorecards
Teams that need a free ATS tier (Breezy Bootstrap)
Buyers whose primary job is payroll or core HRIS
tradeoffs: Published free tiers vs paid depth for ATS, WFM, time, or training jobs
Hub / multi-module pricing complexity vs single-product floors
Mobile/frontline readiness vs desk-bound admin depth
Opaque contact-sales pricing vs transparent published seats
recommendation: Choose Workable when you want a dedicated ATS with published SMB floors and a trial — not when you need Greenhouse-depth structured hiring, a free ATS, or payroll/HRIS as the primary job. Compare Greenhouse for structured enterprise hiring, Breezy HR for a free Bootstrap ATS, and BambooHR if the real purchase is core HRIS.

criterionAssessments.rationale: SMB-friendly ATS with a 15-day trial and published floors is easier to start than Greenhouse quotes. Not hands-on lab tested.
Primary job is ATS/recruiting with optional HRIS-lite. Scored as an ATS peer — not a core HRIS or payroll platform.
Sourcing + ATS + optional onboarding/time-off is solid mid-market depth; structured-hiring kits are not Greenhouse-class.
LinkedIn/Slack/Zapier-style connectors are adequate; ecosystem is thinner than Greenhouse’s marketplace.
Recruiting mobile plus light employee HR features; not frontline WFM.
Hiring reports on paid tiers; custom report builder is Enterprise-gated.
Headcount-band pricing scales, but unpublished higher bands and ATS-first design cap it versus enterprise TA suites.
Published $299 floor and trial are clearer than Greenhouse quotes; add-ons and headcount bands raise TCO. Affiliate economics excluded.
Workable Agent with 3,000 included credits is a real AI path with usage packaging — not unlimited included AI.

overallScoreRationale: Weighted average of the nine HR editorial criteria using the category weights (hiring/workforce fit 15, workflow depth 14, ease of use 12, integrations 12, value 12, mobile/frontline 10, scalability 9, analytics 8, AI 8), rounded to 1 decimal. Products are scored inside their job cluster — ATS, core HRIS, payroll/benefits, people-platform, frontline WFM, time & attendance, SOP training, and LMS peers are not forced into one undifferentiated ranking. Not a hands-on lab score, and affiliate economics are excluded.
